profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer. Accomplished attorney. Entrepreneur. 

Currently at Apple where I'm a Senior Software Engineer working on the News, Stocks, and Weather apps.

Worked on enterprise-facing iOS, Android, and Mac OS X applications at BlueFletch.

Founded and ran multiple small businesses. Experienced building software products and growing consumer-facing businesses. 

Argued before The Supreme Court of Georgia (as first-chair attorney), and convinced the Court to overturn and void a $2,000,000 judgment that had previously been entered against our client.

Favorite personal side project: Built iPhone App - BeltTour. A GPS-guided audio walking tour of a popular tourist destination in Atlanta.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack software developer, currently focusing on consumer and enterprise-facing iOS, Mac OS X, and Android applications.

I have deep experience with Swift, Objective-C, Android, Java, WebRTC, many Apple and Google frameworks and dozens of common libraries, like AFNetworking and RxSwift. I have a mastery of Git, and am completely comfortable on the command line. Some sample projects are detailed below.

Deal Rover.  Coca-Cola. 
* Architected and implemented logic for location-based coupon and notification app using Swift 3.
* Conceptualized and built beautiful and engaging map feature which allowed for a single pin to elegantly present information to users about multiple coupons at that single location. 
* Increased reliability of notification deliveries to near perfect by eliminating reliance on background networking calls, and instead, instantly retrieving local information from Core Data.
* Worked with design, client, and development teams to ensure perfect quality and meet tight deadlines.

Screen Casting Project. 
* Designed and created native Android app to project an Android device's screen to a nearby TV.
* Implemented all native WebRTC logic, including socket-signaling emitter, and node.js backend server.
* Organized large codebase into easily readable and very maintainable discreet classes and projects, allowing for intuitive, well-defined abstraction.
* Carefully managed activity and custom-class lifecycles to eliminate memory leaks, and to ensure live-stream would never be interrupted while app is in background.

Communication Tool Project.
* Built native Mac OS X client for a robust tool similar to Skype as part of a four person team.  
* Abstracted shared code into separate frameworks for easy reuse by the remote iOS team.
* Personally responsible for the multimedia messaging feature, where users could send video snippets, photos, gifs, documents, and more in the body of a chat message.

positions.title: Staff Attorney to Chief Judge David P. Darden
positions.description:
Manage hundreds of  cases, consisting of civil, garnishment, and criminal matters

Draft long-form and well reasoned court orders on 500+ cases; all decided appeals affirmed

Research extensively legal issues before the court, including civil procedure, admissibility of evidence, contracts, jurisdiction, negligence and intentional torts 

Prepare and draft bench briefs for each civil motions calendar and lead pre-hearing meeting with Judge

Communicate and maintain relationships with lawyers, pro-se parties, and court personnel regarding procedural inquiries, trials, motions, pre-trial conferences, and chamber conferences

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Swift iPhone app. GPS-guided audio walking tour of a popular tourist destination in Atlanta.

In App Purchase with Apple-hosted downloads. Thinned audio-heavy app to below 100MB limit.

Clean and intuitive UX; user can forget about their phone and enjoy the moment.

Conducted audio interviews with many interesting people and edited the footage for the in-app audio.

CoreLocation, MapKit, AVFoundation, AVKit, CoreGraphics, Parse, UITableViews, etc.

positions.title: Technical Co-Founder
positions.description:
Created and grew online-only business. 

PHP-coded the site’s main function, which takes user input, generates a customized PDF file for each customer, and sends it to them via email. 

Manage all components of the site and 3rd party resources: WordPress, Gravity Forms, SSL Certificates, Payment-processing, MailChimp, Adwords, Analytics and others.

Design and implement all marketing strategies (CPC, SEO, email, social, etc.) based on detailed analysis of visitor and customer data.

Doubled revenue by implementing affiliate sales strategy; created additional site-features for affiliates.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Built and ran fully-automated and beautiful website that provided custom legal documents to protect same-sex couples living in states that did not recognize gay marriage.

positions.title: Litigation Associate
positions.description:
I worked on complicated business litigation matters at both the trial and appellate level. I represent plaintiffs and defendants. 

I argued before The Supreme Court of Georgia (as first-chair attorney), and convinced the Court to overturn and void a $2,000,000 judgment that had previously been entered against our client.

positions.title: Managing Editor
positions.description: Manage budget of over $3,000 for the journal. Managed finances for the 2012 JIPL Conference, with 12 panelists from 4 different countries and over 90 attendees. Coordinated write on process where to narrow 150+ applicants down to 33.

positions.title: Legal Researcher
positions.description: Coauthored course book for an IP law class in preparation for the opening of Bhutan's first law school.

positions.title: Legal Intern
positions.description:
- Prepared memorandums for clients and lawyers after thoroughly researching legal issues such as: collecting judgments abroad; the Supremacy Clause’s relationship to states’ door closing statutes; and patenting the computer code in ‘intelligent’ stoplights

- Drafted briefs and motions involving Federal and State Rules of Civil Procedure

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked directly for the CFO. Duties and responsibilities included in depth financial analysis of prospective communities, assistance to the accounting department

positions.title: Director of the High Adventure Area
positions.description:
- Organized, planned, and executed a 300-600 scout daily high adventure program including equestrian, and white water rafting in three different venues

- Managed a staff of 6. Responsible for all communication, coordination, scheduling, and financial reporting of camp personnel, bus company, rafting company, and horse camp

educations.schoolName: University of Georgia School of Law

certifications.name: Divide and Conquer, Sorting and Searching, and Randomized Algorithms by Stanford University on Coursera.
